theorem lg_target {r x : ℝ} : HasDerivAt (fun a => -Real.exp (-(r * a))) (r * Real.exp (-(r * x))) x := by
  have h_exp : HasDerivAt Real.exp (Real.exp x) x := Real.hasDerivAt_exp x
  have h_f : HasDerivAt (fun a => Real.exp (-(r * a))) (-r * Real.exp (-(r * x))) x :=
    HasDerivAt.exp h_exp (by simp only [Real.exp_neg, Real.neg_mul, Real.mul_assoc])
  exact HasDerivAt.neg h_f
